title: A Paid Fee & Fixes Update 💰
excerpt: Database improvements, bug fixes, faster loading, improved headshots, FR+ fixes, and quality-of-life improvements.
body:
For more than a month, I wasn’t able to pay for the database, which caused bugs and prevented some users’ data from saving properly.

That changes with this update.

The database fee has now been paid, meaning your data will continue to save properly — even if you uninstall and reinstall the extension.

Enjoy this new version with faster loading, improved performance, fewer bugs, and a smoother experience overall!

added.moreInfo: Users can now select the type of thumbnail shown in the popup and Rocaptcha.
Users unfriended from the Roblox website can now automatically be added to Unfriend History.
Added a new logo placement on the removal screen.

removed.moreInfo: Removed rotating messages that displayed FR+ features inside the popup.
Removed the game icon background from headshots.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed notifications not appearing correctly after removing friends.
Fixed FR+ detection not working correctly.

fixed.text: Notify if a Friend Removes You setting
fixed.moreInfo: Fixed the setting not enabling correctly.
Fixed missing translation keys across supported languages.

improved.moreInfo: The database fee has been paid, allowing user data to continue saving properly even after uninstalling and reinstalling the extension.
Increased inactivity checking interval from 1 minute to 5 minutes.
Removed unnecessary local storage systems and moved more data handling to the backend.
Improved avatar quality for medium-sized friend lists. Compact Viewer avatars from 151–300 friends now load at a higher resolution instead of appearing blurry.
Added a smooth zoom animation when viewing headshots in the popup.
The menu button is now disabled during error screens.
The removal screen no longer appears when removing 5 friends or fewer.
Game names now have enough room to display fully instead of being cut off.
Changed the default color to red to celebrate Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
Improved FR+ data reliability with the new backend worker system.
